tables.name: log_ingestion
tables.description: Loader log: one row per delivered micro-batch. Completeness of a table-hour = SUM(share).

columns.description: fact view name, e.g. fact_orders_hourly

columns.name: ts
columns.description: hour the batch belongs to

columns.name: batch
columns.description: micro-batch number

columns.name: share
columns.description: fraction of the hour's source events in this batch
